audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..2] and content win[0..2] all give Gangplank levels 1-3, but the packet level chart gives Skill for those rows and the content whys say the opposite in words ('Even and dead', 'Still even', 'Neither of us spikes here').
audit.why: Sejuani has no waveclear and no kill pattern before Frost stacks, but Gangplank has one destructible keg and 625 range against a 650-range Arctic Assault; the stage is genuinely even, which is what the packet chart and the prose already say.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-3 set to Skill at 5/10 in both layers; rows 4-7 left as they are (they already match the packet chart).

audit.why: Content spikes name the real windows: her level-6 Arctic Assault into Permafrost or Glacial Prison dive, and Gangplank's Sheen keg-chain first item. Four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer is built on 'track Permafrost's cooldown' and 'engage when Permafrost is down'. Permafrost's cooldown is 1.5 seconds — it is effectively always up. It is gated by Frost stacks, not by cooldown, so the advice sends you into the one thing you should be avoiding.
audit.why: Riot text, Permafrost (E): 'Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks', cooldown 1.5s, cost 20. Winter's Wrath (W, 9/8/7/6/5, 600 range) and her autos are what apply the stacks; her passive Fury of the North shatters a stunned target for heavy magic damage. Her only gap-closer is Arctic Assault (Q), 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s at 650 range. Remove Scurvy (W, 22/20/18/16/14) cures the stun.
audit.corrected: Advice re-keyed to Frost stacks and Arctic Assault's 12-18s cooldown; Permafrost's 1.5s cooldown stated so nobody waits it out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing cues; the cooldown section carries no numbers.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown here is Arctic Assault at 18s rank 1, not Permafrost.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[9].t.
